learningGoal: Help Reina notice that flat sides can leave prints, while curved surfaces roll and do not make flat 2D faces.
misconception: A curved surface can act like a flat face.

sourceEvidence.summary: Homework asks the child to identify flat faces of three-dimensional shapes.

engagementWrapper.label: Whimsical Quest
engagementWrapper.promptLanguage: Make it whimsical, cute, playful, warm, and quest-like. Use wonder and tiny surprises, not academic lecture language.

assumptions: Reina may need a visual model before independent retrieval on 2D faces of 3D solids.
A Stamp Quest wrapper may make the geometry feel like a playful investigation instead of a worksheet lecture.
The explainer is an intervention, not proof of mastery.
falsifyCriteria: delayed concept-check or graded homework contradicts the in-app result

researchNotes.summary: Math intervention should include visual representations when the child needs a concrete model.
Follow the explanation with feedback-rich retrieval; watching is not mastery.

reuseDecision.reason: Discovery artifact for a geometry/spatial visual explainer trigger.

parentApproval.notes: Needs parent review for visual quality and narration pacing.

timings.text: Welcome to Stamp Quest. Six shapes are lining up for the magic stamp pad.
Watch each shape spin. If it has a flat side, it can press down and leave a print.
Here comes the test. Flat sides touch the pad like a stamp.
Quick pick. One shape is all curve, and it is going to roll away. Which one is it?
The prints are in. Cube makes square. Prism makes rectangle. Cylinder and cone make circles. Pyramid makes triangle.
The sphere cannot press down flat, so it rolls off with no print. Flat makes a face. Curved makes a roll.

questions.prompt: Which one rolls away without making a flat print?

companionContext.hintText: Look for the shape that cannot touch the pad with a flat side.

hintsByPhase.intro: Watch for which shapes have a flat side that can touch the pad.
hintsByPhase.rotate: If the side can press down flat, it can make a print.
hintsByPhase.stamp: The stamp pad only works when a flat side touches it.
hintsByPhase.prediction: Look for the shape that is all curve and no flat side.
hintsByPhase.reveal: Compare the prints on the pad to the shape that rolled away.
hintsByPhase.review: Flat makes a print. Curved rolls.

questions.prompt: Which solid can stamp a square?
Which shape rolls away without making a flat print?
Which solids can stamp a circle with a flat base?
